```csharp
using System;
using System.Drawing.Printing;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Mail;
using System.Net.Mime;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Serilog;
using Telerik.Reporting;
using Telerik.Reporting.Processing;

namespace Logistix.Server.Application.Handlers.Infrastructure.Reporting
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles generating, printing, and emailing Telerik reports.
    /// </summary>
    public class ReportingHandler : IReportingHandler
    {
        public ReportingHandler()
        {
            Log.Information("ReportingHandler initialized.");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sends a Telerik report to a specified printer.
        /// </summary>
        public bool SendReportToPrinter(ReportRequestModel request)
        {
            if (request == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ReportPath) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.PrinterName))
            {
                Log.Warning("Invalid print request. ReportPath: {ReportPath}, Printer: {PrinterName}", request?.ReportPath, request?.PrinterName);
                return false;
            }

            try
            {
                var reportSource = LoadReport(request.ReportPath);
                var reportProcessor = new ReportProcessor();
                var printSettings = new PrinterSettings { PrinterName = request.PrinterName };

                reportProcessor.PrintReport(reportSource, printSettings);

                Log.Information("Report {ReportPath} successfully sent to printer: {PrinterName}", request.ReportPath, request.PrinterName);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Error(ex, "Error printing report {ReportPath}.", request.ReportPath);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sends a Telerik report as a PDF attachment via email.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> SendReportToEmail(ReportEmailRequestModel request)
        {
            if (request == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ReportPath) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Email))
            {
                Log.Warning("Invalid email request. ReportPath: {ReportPath}, Email: {Email}", request?.ReportPath, request?.Email);
                return false;
            }

            try
            {
                var reportSource = LoadReport(request.ReportPath);
                var reportBytes = RenderReportToPDF(reportSource);

                using var smtpClient = new SmtpClient("smtp.yourserver.com")
                {
                    Credentials = new System.Net.NetworkCredential("your-email", "your-password"),
                    EnableSsl = true
                };

                var mailMessage = new MailMessage
                {
                    From = new MailAddress("no-reply@yourcompany.com"),
                    Subject = "Requested Report",
                    Body = "Please find the requested report attached.",
                    IsBodyHtml = true
                };
                mailMessage.To.Add(request.Email);
                mailMessage.Attachments.Add(new Attachment(new MemoryStream(reportBytes), "Report.pdf", MediaTypeNames.Application.Pdf));

                await smtpClient.SendMailAsync(mailMessage);

                Log.Information("Report {ReportPath} successfully sent via email to {Email}", request.ReportPath, request.Email);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Error(ex, "Exception occurred while sending report {ReportPath} via email.", request.ReportPath);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Returns a Telerik report as a downloadable PDF file.
        /// </summary>
        public byte[] GetReport(string reportPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reportPath))
            {
                Log.Warning("Invalid report retrieval request. ReportPath: {ReportPath}", reportPath);
                return Array.Empty<byte>();
            }

            try
            {
                var reportSource = LoadReport(reportPath);
                var reportBytes = RenderReportToPDF(reportSource);

                Log.Information("Generated PDF report: {ReportPath}", reportPath);
                return reportBytes;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Error(ex, "Error generating report {ReportPath}.", reportPath);
                return Array.Empty<byte>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Loads a Telerik report from the specified path.
        /// </summary>
        private static UriReportSource LoadReport(string reportPath)
        {
            return new UriReportSource { Uri = reportPath };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Renders a Telerik report to a PDF byte array.
        /// </summary>
        private static byte[] RenderReportToPDF(ReportSource reportSource)
        {
            var reportProcessor = new ReportProcessor();
            var result = reportProcessor.RenderReport("PDF", reportSource, null);

            if (result.HasErrors)
            {
                Log.Error("Error rendering report: {Errors}", string.Join(", ", result.Errors));
                throw new Exception("Error rendering report.");
            }

            return result.DocumentBytes;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Request model for printing a report.
    /// </summary>
    public class ReportRequestModel
    {
        public string ReportPath { get; set; }
        public string PrinterName { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Request model for emailing a report.
    /// </summary>
    public class ReportEmailRequestModel
    {
        public string ReportPath { get; set; }
        public string Email { get; set; }
    }
}
```

### **✅ Restored and Fixed `JobHandler.cs`**
```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Logistix.Server.Infrastructure.Database.Entity.Domain.Job;
using Logistix.Server.Infrastructure.Database;
using Logistix.Server.Application.Services.AlertService;
using Serilog;

public class JobHandler : IJobHandler
{
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> _incomingRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobProcessingEntity> _processingRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobInRouteEntity> _inRouteRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobCompleteEntity> _completeRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobArchivedEntity> _archivedRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobAbandonedEntity> _abandonedRepository;
    private readonly INotificationService _alertService;

    public JobHandler(
        IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> incomingRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobProcessingEntity> processingRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobInRouteEntity> inRouteRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobCompleteEntity> completeRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobArchivedEntity> archivedRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobAbandonedEntity> abandonedRepository,
        INotificationService alertService)
    {
        _incomingRepository = incomingRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(incomingRepository));
        _processingRepository = processingRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(processingRepository));
        _inRouteRepository = inRouteRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inRouteRepository));
        _completeRepository = completeRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(completeRepository));
        _archivedRepository = archivedRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(archivedRepository));
        _abandonedRepository = abandonedRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(abandonedRepository));
        _alertService = alertService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(alertService));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a job to the incoming queue.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<OperationResult> AddJobToIncomingQueue(BaseJobEntity jobEntity)
    {
        if (jobEntity == null)
        {
            Log.Warning("Attempted to add a null job entity to incoming queue.");
            return OperationResult.Failure("Invalid job data.");
        }

        try
        {
            var newJob = jobEntity.ConvertTo<JobIncomingEntity>();
            await _incomingRepository.AddAsync(newJob);
            Log.Information("Job added to incoming queue. JobGUID: {JobGUID}", jobEntity.JobGUID);
            return OperationResult.Success();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Error(ex, "Error adding job to incoming queue.");
            return OperationResult.Failure("Failed to add job.");
        }
    }

    private async Task<OperationResult> ExecuteTransactionAsync(Func<Task> action, string operationDescription)
    {
        await using var transaction = await _incomingRepository.BeginTransactionAsync();
        try
        {
            await action();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();
            return OperationResult.Success();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            Log.Error(ex, "Transaction failed: {OperationDescription}", operationDescription);
            return OperationResult.Failure($"Failed to {operationDescription}.");
        }
    }

    public async Task<OperationResult> MoveJobToProcessingQueue(int id)
    {
        return await ExecuteTransactionAsync(async () =>
        {
            var incomingJob = await _incomingRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (incomingJob == null)
            {
                Log.Warning("Incoming job not found for processing. ID: {Id}", id);
                return;
            }

            await _processingRepository.AddAsync(incomingJob.ConvertTo<JobProcessingEntity>());
            await _incomingRepository.DeleteAsync(id);
            Log.Information("Job moved to processing. ID: {Id}", id);
        }, "move job to processing");
    }

    public async Task<OperationResult> MoveJobToInRouteQueue(int id)
    {
        return await ExecuteTransactionAsync(async () =>
        {
            var processingJob = await _processingRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (processingJob == null)
            {
                Log.Warning("Processing job not found for in-route transition. ID: {Id}", id);
                return;
            }

            await _inRouteRepository.AddAsync(processingJob.ConvertTo<JobInRouteEntity>());
            await _processingRepository.DeleteAsync(id);
            Log.Information("Job moved to in-route. ID: {Id}", id);
        }, "move job to in-route");
    }

    public async Task<OperationResult> MoveJobToClosed(int id)
    {
        return await ExecuteTransactionAsync(async () =>
        {
            var inRouteJob = await _inRouteRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (inRouteJob == null)
            {
                Log.Warning("In-route job not found for closure. ID: {Id}", id);
                return;
            }

            await _completeRepository.AddAsync(inRouteJob.ConvertTo<JobCompleteEntity>());
            await _inRouteRepository.DeleteAsync(id);
            Log.Information("Job moved to closed. ID: {Id}", id);
        }, "move job to closed");
    }

    public async Task<OperationResult> ArchiveJob(int id)
    {
        return await ExecuteTransactionAsync(async () =>
        {
            var completedJob = await _completeRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (completedJob == null)
            {
                Log.Warning("Completed job not found for archiving. ID: {Id}", id);
                return;
            }

            await _archivedRepository.AddAsync(completedJob.ConvertTo<JobArchivedEntity>());
            await _completeRepository.DeleteAsync(id);
            Log.Information("Job archived. ID: {Id}", id);
        }, "archive job");
    }

    public async Task<OperationResult> AbandonJob(int id)
    {
        return await ExecuteTransactionAsync(async () =>
        {
            var incomingJob = await _incomingRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (incomingJob == null)
            {
                Log.Warning("Incoming job not found for abandonment. ID: {Id}", id);
                return;
            }

            await _abandonedRepository.AddAsync(incomingJob.ConvertTo<JobAbandonedEntity>());
            await _incomingRepository.DeleteAsync(id);
            Log.Information("Job abandoned. ID: {Id}", id);
        }, "abandon job");
    }
}
```

---

### **🔧 What This Fixes**

    public JobHandler(

        IGenericRepository<JobProcessingEntity> processingRepository,

        IGenericRepository<JobCompleteEntity> completeRepository,

        _abandonedRepository = abandonedRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(abandonedRepository));

        _alertService = alertService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(alertService));

    }



    /// <summary>

    /// Executes the provided action within a transactional context.

    /// Assumes that the repository exposes asynchronous transaction management methods:

    /// BeginTransactionAsync, CommitTransactionAsync, and RollbackTransactionAsync.

    /// </summary>

    /// <typeparam name="T">A reference type representing the entity.</typeparam>

    /// <param name="action">

    /// An asynchronous delegate that receives an IGenericRepository&lt;T&gt; instance.

    /// </param>

    /// <param name="repository">The repository instance to use for transaction management.</param>

    private async Task ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>(Func<IGenericRepository<T>, Task> action, IGenericRepository<T> repository)

        where T : class

    {

        // Initiate the transaction. BeginTransactionAsync is executed as a statement.

        await repository.BeginTransactionAsync();

        try

        {

            await action(repository);

            await repository.CommitTransactionAsync();

        }

        catch (Exception ex)

        {

            await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();

            Log.Error(ex, "Transaction rolled back due to exception.");

            throw;

        }

    }

    public async Task PushJobIntoProcessing(int id)

    {

        await ExecuteTransactionAsync<JobIncomingEntity>(async repo =>

        {

            var incomingJob = await repo.GetByIdAsync(id);

            if (incomingJob != null)

            {

                var processingJob = incomingJob.ConvertTo<JobProcessingEntity>();

                await _processingRepository.AddAsync(processingJob);

                await repo.DeleteAsync(id);

                Log.Information("Job {Id} moved from incoming to processing successfully.", id);

```csharp
using System.Threading.Tasks;

using Logistix.Server.Infrastructure.Database;
using Logistix.Server.Application.Services.NotificationService;
using Serilog;

public class JobHandler 
{
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> _incomingRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobProcessingEntity> _processingRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobInRouteEntity> _inRouteRepository;
    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobCompleteEntity> _completeRepository;

    private readonly IGenericRepository<JobAbandoned> _abandonedRepository;
    private readonly INotificationService _alertService;

    public JobHandler(
        IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> incomingRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobProcessingEntity> processingRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobInRouteEntity> inRouteRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobCompleteEntity> completeRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobArchived> archivedRepository,
        IGenericRepository<JobAbandoned> abandonedRepository,
        INotificationService alertService)
    {
        _incomingRepository = incomingRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(incomingRepository));
        _processingRepository = processingRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(processingRepository));
        _inRouteRepository = inRouteRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inRouteRepository));
        _completeRepository = completeRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(completeRepository));
        _archivedRepository = archivedRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(archivedRepository));
        _abandonedRepository = abandonedRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(abandonedRepository));
        _alertService = alertService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(alertService));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the provided action within a transactional context.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>(Func<IGenericRepository<T>, Task> action, IGenericRepository<T> repository)
        where T : class
    {
        await repository.BeginTransactionAsync();
        try
        {
            await action(repository);
            await repository.CommitTransactionAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();
            Log.Error(ex, "Transaction rolled back due to exception.");
            throw;
        }
    }

            throw new ArgumentException("Invalid job data.");
        }

        await _incomingRepository.AddAsync(jobEntity.ConvertTo<JobIncomingEntity>());
        Log.Information("Job added to incoming queue. JobGUID: {JobGUID}", jobEntity.JobGUID);
    }

    public async Task PushJobIntoProcessing(int id)

            if (incomingJob != null)
            {
                var processingJob = incomingJob.ConvertTo<JobProcessingEntity>();
                await _processingRepository.AddAsync(processingJob);
                await repo.DeleteAsync(id);
                Log.Information("Job {Id} moved from incoming to processing successfully.", id);
            }
            else
            {
                Log.Warning("Incoming job with ID {Id} not found.", id);
            }
        }, _incomingRepository);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Routes a processing job into the "in-route" state.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task PushJobIntoRouted(int id)
    {
        await ExecuteTransactionAsync<JobProcessingEntity>(async repo =>
        {
            var processingJob = await repo.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (processingJob != null)
            {
                var inRouteJob = processingJob.ConvertTo<JobInRouteEntity>();
                await _inRouteRepository.AddAsync(inRouteJob);
                await repo.DeleteAsync(id);

            }
        }, _processingRepository);

    public async Task PushJobIntoCompleted(int id)

        {

    public async Task PushJobIntoArchived(int id)
    {
```

        public Guid JobGUID { get; set; }

        public string JobMetaData { get; set; }

        private string _invoiceJson = "{}";

        private string _routingJson = "{}";

        private string _dispatchJson = "{}";

            set => _billingJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, _jsonOptions);

        }

        {

            get => _billingJson;

            set => _billingJson = value;

        {

        [Required, Column("dispatch_json", TypeName = "nvarchar(max)")]

        public string SerializedDispatchJson

        {

            get => _dispatchJson;

            set => _dispatchJson = value;

        }

        public dynamic InventoryJson

        {

            get => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<dynamic>(_inventoryJson, _jsonOptions);

            set => _inventoryJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, _jsonOptions);

        }

        public string SerializedInventoryJson

        {

            get => _inventoryJson;

            set => _inventoryJson = value;

        }



        public T ConvertTo<T>() where T : BaseJobEntity, new()

        {

            try

            {

                var target = new T

                {

                    Id = this.Id,  // Usually not copied if ID is database generated

                    JobGUID = this.JobGUID,

                    JobInternalID = this.JobInternalID,

                    JobJsonData = this.JobJsonData,

                    CustomerJsonData = this.CustomerJsonData,

                    ShipperJsonData = this.ShipperJsonData,

                    ConsigneeJsonData = this.ConsigneeJsonData,

                    JobBlobData = this.JobBlobData?.ToArray(),  // Assuming a deep copy for arrays

                    JobMetaData = this.JobMetaData,

                    DateCreated = this.DateCreated,

                    // Copying JSON data correctly

                    _billingJson = this._billingJson,

                    _invoiceJson = this._invoiceJson,

                    _routingJson = this._routingJson,

                    _dispatchJson = this._dispatchJson,

                    _inventoryJson = this._inventoryJson,

                    RowVersion = this.RowVersion.ToArray()  // Assuming a deep copy for arrays

                };

                return target;

            }

            catch (Exception ex)

            {

                // Log or handle the error accordingly

                throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to convert job entity", ex);

            }

        }

    }

## ASSISTANT
Yes, you should **dump `ToEntity<T>()` and use AutoMapper** instead. Here's why:

---

### **✅ Why Use AutoMapper Instead of `ToEntity<T>()`?**
1. **Less Manual Code** – AutoMapper automatically maps DTOs to entities, reducing redundancy.
2. **Consistency** – Ensures all transformations are handled in a unified way across all handlers.
3. **Extensibility** – You can **easily update mapping logic** without modifying DTOs/entities.
4. **Better Maintainability** – Keeps DTOs **clean** without conversion logic cluttering them.

---

### **🔧 How to Implement AutoMapper for Job DTOs**
1. **Install AutoMapper NuGet package**  
   ```
   dotnet add package AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection
   ```

2. **Create a Mapping Profile**
   Create a `JobMappingProfile.cs` file:

   ```csharp
   using AutoMapper;
   using Logistix.Server.Infrastructure.Database.Entity.Domain.Job;
   using Logistix.Server.Application.Models;

   namespace Logistix.Server.Application.MappingProfiles
   {
       public class JobMappingProfile : Profile
       {
           public JobMappingProfile()
           {
               // Base Entity Mapping
               CreateMap<BaseJobEntity, JobDto>().ReverseMap();

               // Derived Entities Mapping
               CreateMap<JobIncomingEntity, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
               CreateMap<JobProcessingEntity, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
               CreateMap<JobInRouteEntity, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
               CreateMap<JobCompleteEntity, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
               CreateMap<JobArchived, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
               CreateMap<JobAbandoned, JobDto>().ReverseMap();
           }
       }
   }
   ```

3. **Register AutoMapper in `Program.cs`**
   ```csharp
   builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(JobMappingProfile));
   ```

4. **Use AutoMapper in Handlers**
   Example in `JobHandler.cs`:
   ```csharp
   public class JobHandler : IJobHandler
   {
       private readonly IMapper _mapper;
       private readonly IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> _incomingRepository;

       public JobHandler(IMapper mapper, IGenericRepository<JobIncomingEntity> incomingRepository)
       {
           _mapper = mapper ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mapper));
           _incomingRepository = incomingRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(incomingRepository));
       }

       public async Task<OperationResult> AddJobToIncomingQueue(JobDto jobDto)
       {
           var entity = _mapper.Map<JobIncomingEntity>(jobDto);
           await _incomingRepository.AddAsync(entity);
           return OperationResult.Success("Job added to incoming queue.");
       }
   }
   ```

### **🚀 Benefits of Using AutoMapper**
✔ **Eliminates manual `ToEntity<T>()` conversion**  
✔ **Automatically maps DTOs to entities & vice versa**  
✔ **Easier to extend in the future**  
✔ **Faster development with fewer errors**  

### **📌 Final Answer: Dump `ToEntity<T>()`, Use AutoMapper!** 🚀

## **🔧 Proper Fix for `ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>`**
Instead of **forcing a return type**, update `ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>` to **support transformation** while keeping transactions correct.

### **📝 FIX: Change `ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>`**
```csharp
private async Task<OperationResult<TResult>> ExecuteTransactionAsync<TRepository, TResult>(
    Func<IGenericRepository<TRepository>, Task<OperationResult<TResult>>> action,
    IGenericRepository<TRepository> repository)
    where TRepository : class
{
    await repository.BeginTransactionAsync();
    try
    {
        var result = await action(repository);
        if (!result.IsSuccessful)
        {
            await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();
            return result;
        }

        await repository.CommitTransactionAsync();
        return result;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();
        Log.Error(ex, "Transaction failed.");
        return OperationResult<TResult>.Failure(default, "Transaction failed.");
    }
}
```
✅ **Key Fixes**
- Now **supports transformation** (`TRepository` → `TResult`).
- Ensures proper **transaction rollback** on failure.
- Works with **AutoMapper**.

```csharp
public class OperationResult<T>
{
    public bool IsSuccessful { get; private set; }
    public string Message { get; private set; }
    public T? Data { get; private set; }

    private OperationResult(bool isSuccess, T? data, string message)
    {
        IsSuccessful = isSuccess;
        Data = data;
        Message = message;
    }

    public static OperationResult<T> Success(T data, string message = "Operation successful.")
    {
        return new OperationResult<T>(true, data, message);
    }

    public static OperationResult<T> Failure(T? data = default, string message = "Operation failed.")
    {
        return new OperationResult<T>(false, data, message);
    }
}
```

### **🛠 Restoring Transactions**

```csharp
private async Task<OperationResult<T>> ExecuteTransactionAsync<T>(
    Func<IGenericRepository<T>, Task<OperationResult<T>>> action, IGenericRepository<T> repository) where T : class
{
    await repository.BeginTransactionAsync();
    try
    {
        var result = await action(repository);
        if (!result.IsSuccessful)
        {
            await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();
            return result;
        }

        await repository.CommitTransactionAsync();
        return result;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        await repository.RollbackTransactionAsync();
        Log.Error(ex, "Transaction failed.");
        return OperationResult<T>.Failure(default, "Transaction failed.");
    }
}
```
✅ **Restores transaction rollback/commit**  
✅ **Ensures correct handling of success/failure**
